title: GodKing Zeus Drops Cinematic Trap Experience with "The Plug"
htmlContent:
Toronto-based rapper and songwriter GodKing Zeus is back with a new track, "The Plug," showcasing his flashy lyrics and real-life experiences. 

Surviving a broken home and now a father of two, Zeus is embracing his role as a leader of the next generation. Collaborating with producers Aloysius Brown and Jules Lynch, Zeus has created a new sound that sets him apart from his peers.

"The Plug" marks the first single off Zeus' upcoming EP and is a cinematic trap experience that hits hard. The song showcases Zeus' storytelling abilities and paints a picture of the modern Godfather. With its catchy beats and raw lyrics, "The Plug" is a must-listen for fans of rap music.

http://open.spotify.com/album/2Yxdxxr2NkA11xxU9Dd5xQ 

The single is available through Nucleus Entertainment and distributed worldwide by Believe Distribution. Take advantage of this exciting new release from GodKing Zeus.
